  "background": "Born Jordan Martin Mallory West, to Samantha West and John Maximilian West. Both of his parents were successful investment bankers, this meant as a child his life was pleasant but uneventful. \n\nThis changed when he turned 13 and he awakened. An exceptionally smart kid, his parents decided to bring in a hermetic mage to give him private tutelage were he learnt the basics spellcasting, summoning and the arcane.   "background": "Born Jordan Martin Mallory West, to Samantha West and John Maximilian West. Both of his parents were successful investment bankers, this meant as a child his life was pleasant but uneventful. \n\nThis changed when he turned 13 and he awakened. An exceptionally smart kid, his parents decided to bring in a hermetic mage to give him private tutelage were he learnt the basics spellcasting, summoning and the arcane.
